Class SocketClientHandlersManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.socket.server.SocketClientHandlersManager
public class SocketClientHandlersManager extends Object
Manages the lifecycle of multiple client socket connections on the server side. It is responsible for accepting new inbound sockets, matching primary connections with their ping counterparts, spawning dedicated listener and buffering threads for each client, and routing incoming requests to the LobbyController.

    • runServer

      public void runServer() throws IOException
      Starts the main server loop to accept incoming client connections on the primary port. For each connection, it instantiates a handler, places it in the waiting area, and spawns two threads: one for interpreting client requests and another for asynchronously buffering and pushing updates to the client.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the server socket encounters a critical error during acceptance.

    • runPingServer

      public void runPingServer() throws IOException
      Starts the background loop to accept incoming secondary ping connections on the designated ping port. Extracts the requested nickname from the first message to associate this ping socket with an already connected handler, then spawns a dedicated listener thread to maintain the online status of the client.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the ping server socket encounters an error during acceptance.

    • receiveRequest

      public void receiveRequest(ClientRequest request, SocketClientHandler sender)
      Processes incoming client requests forwarded by individual client handlers. Automatically registers the nickname via the network layer if the client just connected, dispatches the request to the game controller, and handles updating user-to-game mappings.
      Parameters:
      request - the deserialized ClientRequest specifying the action to perform.
      sender - the SocketClientHandler instance representing the client making the request.

    • pingServer

      public void pingServer(String nickname)
      Notifies the controller that a heartbeat ping was received from a specific user, maintaining their active status on the server.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the user who sent the ping.
